notes.title: v1.1.1: Added gamepad support
notes.content:
The game now has gamepad support. The game itself has full support for being played with a gamepad but due to a limitation within my UI system, currently you are unable to changing volume using the gamepad and will have to use mouse for that. 

Fixing the issue with changing volume is something I will get around to eventually but it will have to wait a bit.

I also added control descriptions to the tutorial screen on first start but in case you've missed it the controls are:
DPAD: Movement
X: Undo
Y: Reset
A: Confirm (In menu)
Start: Pause (In Game)

Be sure to leave any feedback you have on the game or this patch.
Thank you for supporting this project!
- Oskar

notes.title: v1.0.1: Updated trophy textures to remove art style discripancy
notes.content:
The bronze, silver and gold trophy textures was in a much higher resolution than the icon to signal the player's number of moves. In order to have a more uniform style those textures has been replaced with a more lower resolution pixel art.

Be sure to leave any feedback you have on the game.
Thank you for supporting this project!
- Oskar
